title: You took my money without providing a service.
body:
My experience:

* Signs up for Claude API, pays $20 for usage credits
* `npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code`
* `claude`
* "Light mode, thank you"
* Sign in
* "Anthropic has paused sign ups to provide the best possible service to customers."
  * Bro, I created an account and paid money; how TF is that not "signed up"?

Give me my money back, and stick something in your docs about "paused sign ups" whenever you feel like not tricking people.
author: Fordi
